located_point.method: Not located. Starting point from Wikidata at arcminute precision. Renders at 4 km and 1.5 km (RGB) show a pale saline flat crossed by a straight modern road and canal, with darker dune ground on both sides; no mound could be identified with confidence.

sources.rights_notice: Copernicus Sentinel data terms; Contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data 2018–2026

notes: The plan library has no Ganweriwala plan (status no-plan-found), and a search of the Internet Archive found no open scan of a site plan. Published work on the site is a surface survey; we know of no excavated architecture plan.
unmeasurable_reason: No plan found and no straight Harappan architecture identifiable in the imagery.
imagery_unmeasurable_reason: Site not located at 10 m; no straight feature other than the modern road and canal.
